reviews.name: Brooke Alexander
reviews.text: We hosted a yoga teacher training here and had such a beautiful experience! Joel and the entire Ayni team go above & beyond to support their guests. The food was incredible and we truly felt right at home. I highly recommend Ayni Sanctuary💛 …

reviews.name: Tricia Sexton
reviews.text: Such a beautiful space in the beautiful valley ☺️. Everyone was so kind and welcoming. I got to walk barefoot in the grass everyday and enjoy the campfire at night. Rooms were cozy and lovely. Plenty of kitchen space to cook. Highly recommend staying at this wonderful sanctuary in the sacred valley!

reviews.name: Andrew Curtis
reviews.text: Beautiful retreat center. They have thought of all the modern comforts to relax and feel at home. The staff are especially friendly and welcoming. Lots of English speaking and inviting nature in the valley.

reviews.name: Lizzy McNeill
reviews.text: Very nice staff! Tried to make us as comfortable as possible and the sacred valley is very special. Missing the ship cafe

reviews.name: Ari Moon
reviews.text: A beautiful and peaceful place to stay. The surroundings are stunning, the space is thoughtfully designed, and the atmosphere is very relaxing. I really enjoyed my time here and would definitely recommend it.

reviews.name: Paul Peterson
reviews.text: We had a beautiful and meaningful experience here. The land feels very special, peaceful, alive, and deeply connected to the natural beauty of Peru. There is a lot of heart, care, and intention behind what is being created, and that came …

reviews.name: Ushu Atlas
reviews.text: My favourite spot in the Sacred Valley ✨

reviews.name: Maria Pucci
reviews.text: Ayni is simply a dream within the Sacred Valley. The place is designed with details that invite connection. Nature, energy, and a staff so attentive and efficient that you won't want to leave. My favorite place, delicious and balanced food. …

reviews.name: Beatriz Almeida
reviews.text:
Ayni is not a place, it's an energy.

I have no words to describe how grateful I am to have found this special place …

reviews.name: Sol (papo de cacau)
reviews.text: I love being here! There's so much peace in this space!

reviews.name: Fernando Tieghi
reviews.text: Ayni is a beautiful place, full of enriching offerings; comfortable accommodations with great attention to detail and well-organized, therapies and ceremonies, delicious food and coffee, art and cultural exchange

reviews.name: Agustina Sigal
reviews.text:
Ayni Sanctuary is the perfect place for retreats. ✨

I was lucky enough to experience this as a volunteer, and I couldn't be more …

reviews.name: Josiane Duarte
reviews.text: Charming place. The comfortable chalets, the fruits and soups at night after a day in the mountains made all the difference, the breakfast was delicious, I recommend it and would return.

reviews.name: Sérgio Cristal Solar
reviews.text: I was there with a group of Brazilians and it was simply magical - the reception, the cleanliness, the food, and the wonderful energy of the place. I highly recommend it!
